$comment: Worked example, not a blank template. This is the real current agent-team state for registry/packages/missed-lead-recovery/v0.1.json, used here to show what a conforming agent-team.json looks like in practice. A new package should copy this file's shape and replace every value, not just the identities. Where this file's status is 'not_started' or 'blocked', that is the honest current state of the real package -- it is not a placeholder that was forgotten.

constitutional_rules.statement: The same agent or identity that builds a package cannot independently certify that package.

workflow_architect.purpose: Turn the missed-lead business problem into a workflow spec: trigger, context, old workflow, new workflow, finish line, edge cases, success metrics.
required_inputs: home-services intake notes on missed inbound leads
evidence_produced: workflow-spec.md committed 2026-07-23, reviewed against SPEC.md's required-concepts section before handoff
escalation_conditions: finish line cannot be defined without live CRM access
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as independent_reviewer or evidence_auditor for this package version

package_builder.purpose: Implement the minimum-viable package file set from the approved workflow spec.
permitted_actions: write agent-spec.md, install-guide equivalent (README.md), agent-handoff.md, artifact-manifest.json
propose a first draft of approval-rules.md
prohibited_actions: mark own build policy-approved, evaluated, audited, published, or certified
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as policy_guardian, evidence_auditor, registry_publisher, or independent_reviewer for this package version -- this is the identity the constitutional rule is written about

policy_guardian.purpose: Verify approval-rules.md and no-go coverage are complete before the package touches a real platform.
required_inputs: docs/ai-agent-buyer-guide.md 'Do not do these things' list
prohibited_actions: approve own added rules without independent recheck
evidence_produced: checklist mapping buyer-guide 'never' items to approval-rules.md lines: send_customer_message, write_customer_record (CRM changes/appointments), invent_price (quoting), invent_availability (promising availability), connect_live_account, request_credentials (real customer data beyond sample) -- all covered
registry evidence.approval_rules: present; policy.no_go covers request_credentials, invent_price, invent_availability, promise_guarantee
escalation_conditions: an autonomous action with no approval gate is requested
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as package_builder or registry_publisher for this package version

platform_adapter.purpose: Adapt the policy-approved package to specific runtimes against the six-point contract in docs/runtime-integrations.md.
prohibited_actions: weaken approval-rules.md or no-go rules to fit a platform's limitations
mark a platform tested without checking all six contract points
required_outputs: one platform_adapters[] entry per target platform
evidence_produced: generic-agent: documented (six-point contract checked manually against approval-rules.md language)
chatgpt, claude, grok, hermes, n8n: planned -- not yet adapted, correctly not claimed as documented or tested
escalation_conditions: a platform cannot enforce no-go rules against a later prompt (contract point 3)
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as runtime_operator or evaluation_agent for a platform they personally adapted, without an independent evaluation gate between adaptation and execution

evaluation_agent.purpose: Run eval-template.csv against the adapted package and report pass/fail per row.
required_inputs: adapted package for at least one non-generic platform
prohibited_actions: edit package files to force a pass
evidence_produced: not yet produced -- registry evidence.recorded_eval_run: pending
escalation_conditions: eval suite has no case covering a declared no-go rule
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as package_builder or platform_adapter for the platform under evaluation

runtime_operator.purpose: Execute the evaluated package for a real or supervised pilot run, operator-present.
permitted_actions: enforce approval gates in real time
prohibited_actions: use data the approval rules didn't clear
required_outputs: one receipt per step (step_id, actor, timestamp, inputs_hash, outputs_hash, approval_ref, evidence_uri)
evidence_produced: not yet produced -- registry evidence.runtime_receipt_chain: pending; artifact.hash_status: pending_canonical_build
escalation_conditions: a no-go rule is nearly triggered
a required approval does not arrive in the allowed window
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as evidence_auditor for their own execution run

evidence_auditor.purpose: Independently verify the receipt chain's integrity and completeness before publication.
permitted_actions: recompute and verify the hash chain
prohibited_actions: audit a chain they personally produced
required_outputs: audit report with a chain-verification result
evidence_produced: not yet produced -- no receipt chain exists yet to audit
escalation_conditions: required evidence fields remain pending past the package's stated maturity
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as runtime_operator or package_builder for this package version

registry_publisher.purpose: Write and keep current the package's registry record and index entry.
permitted_actions: set certification_status up to and including not_independently_verified -- never higher
prohibited_actions: set certification_status to any verified state without a signed Independent Reviewer determination
alter evidence fields after an audit without a new audit
evidence_produced: a registry record for this package already exists (published 2026-07-23, trust_status: documented, certification_status: not_independently_verified) -- but it predates this protocol and was not gated by an EVIDENCE_AUDIT step. It is a legacy documentation-tier publish, not evidence of this role's protocol-conformant output. A protocol-conformant re-publish is blocked pending Evaluation, Execution, and Evidence Audit, which is why lifecycle.current_state below is PLATFORM_ADAPTATION rather than PUBLICATION despite the record's own lifecycle_status already saying 'published'. See the PR's open question on reconciling this.
escalation_conditions: evidence is incomplete and a publish is requested anyway at a higher trust_status than the evidence supports
a pre-protocol record's lifecycle_status implies more certification than this protocol's evidence chain actually supports (the present case)
conflicts_of_interest: must not also serve as package_builder, evidence_auditor, or independent_reviewer for this package version

independent_reviewer.purpose: Serve as the certifying authority distinct from the package author, per docs/workflowware-registry-vision.md's named gap.
required_inputs: package artifact and canonical hash (not yet built)
permitted_actions: issue REVOKED against a previously VERIFIED package
prohibited_actions: hold any of the other eight roles for this package version
required_outputs: independent review report with a signed determination
evidence_produced: none yet -- registry evidence.independent_review: not_performed. This is the accurate current state of the real package, not an oversight in this example.
escalation_conditions: the evidence chain does not independently reproduce
the reviewer discovers an identity overlap elsewhere in the team roster
conflicts_of_interest: full separation from all eight other roles for this package version

history.evidence_ref: intake notes, home-services missed-lead problem statement
